heading: tMEDIC - Legacy

text: The FARADAY tMEDIC system combines the strengths of a number of GE Vernova technologies to form an integrated, scalable transformer monitoring and analysis system. Placing this highly intelligent system at a transformer adds new functionality and value to substation operations.
heading: tMEDIC - Legacy

text: The FARADAY tMEDIC draws on data from sensors and computes IEEE and IEC analysis models to accurately assess the condition and capacity of a transformer unit. The FARADAY tMEDIC incorporates proven technologies such as programmable logic control, database manipulation, high-speed processors and the latest in communications interfaces to provide a comprehensive set of functions:
heading: Features and Benefits

text: Data acquisition: scans status and analog measurements from transformer sensors
heading: Features and Benefits

text: Digital outputs for alarms, warnings and control signals
heading: Features and Benefits

text: Local control outputs to cooling equipment
heading: Features and Benefits

text: Sophisticated IEEE and IEC model computations to determine current transformer operating conditions
heading: Features and Benefits

text: Diagnosis and warning of developing problems from model computation results
heading: Features and Benefits

text: Temporary storage of data and analysis results for periodic access by remote users
heading: Features and Benefits

text: Monitoring of analog limit violations and digital status changes
heading: Features and Benefits

text: Major and/or minor alarm logic for SCADA applications
heading: Features and Benefits

text: Communication of data and information via serial, fiber, modem, wireless, pager, LAN/WAN and Internet
